title: 禅那熟练
note: 不越级冒进；能入、住、出、回顾

evidence.pali: ‘‘Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyya’nti. So na sakkoti vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā…pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ. Tassa evaṃ hoti – ‘yaṃnūnāhaṃ vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihareyya’nti. So na sakkoti vivicceva kāmehi…pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharituṃ. Ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, ‘bhikkhu ubhato bhaṭṭho ubhato parihīno, seyyathāpi sā gāvī pabbateyyā bālā abyattā akhettaññū akusalā visame pabbate carituṃ’’’.
evidence.chinese_simplified: 他这样想：‘我若能平息寻与伺，内心澄净，心一境性，无寻、无伺，定生喜乐，证入第二禅而住，那就好了。’但他无法平息寻与伺……乃至……证入第二禅而住。他又这样想：‘我若能远离诸欲，远离诸不善法，有寻、有伺，离生喜乐，证入初禅而住，那就好了。’但他无法远离诸欲……乃至……证入初禅而住。诸比丘，此比丘被称为‘两头皆失，两头皆损’，犹如那头山牛，愚笨、不熟练、不识牧场、不善于在崎岖的山上行走。
evidence.english: It occurs to him: 'What if, with the stilling of directed thought and evaluation, I were to enter and dwell in the second jhāna, which has internal confidence and unification of mind, is without directed thought and evaluation, and has rapture and happiness born of concentration?' He is not able to, with the stilling of directed thought and evaluation… enter and dwell in the second jhāna. It occurs to him: 'What if, quite secluded from sensual pleasures, secluded from unwholesome states… I were to enter and dwell in the first jhāna?' He is not able to, quite secluded from sensual pleasures… enter and dwell in the first jhāna. This bhikkhu, bhikkhus, is said to be one who has failed in both and lost both, just like that mountain cow that is foolish, inept, unfamiliar with its territory, and unskilled in roaming on rugged mountains.

isolation_reason: 旧图保留的独立概念有直接 V4 逐句证据，但当前闭包没有足够直接的关系句将其连接到另一发布节点；为避免凭概念相似度补边，保留为可检索、可引用的独立节点。

entries.pali: Uppajjitvā niruddhameva bhavaṅgacittaṃ āvajjanacittassa paccayo bhavatīti vuttaṃ ‘‘taṃ niruddhampī’’ ti. Mandathāmagatamevā ti mahatiyā niddāya abhibhūtassa vasena vuttaṃ, kapimiddhaparetassa pana bhavaṅgacittaṃ kadāci āvajjanassa paccayo bhaveyyāti. Bhavaṅgasamayenevā ti bhavaṅgasseva pavattanasamayena paguṇajjhānapaguṇakammaṭṭhānapaguṇaganthesu tesaṃ paguṇabhāveneva ābhogena vināpi manasikāro pavattati. Tathā hi paguṇaṃ ganthaṃ paguṇabhāveneva nirantaraṃ viya ajjhayamāne aññavihitatāya ‘‘ettako gantho gato, ettako avasiṭṭho’’ti sallakkhaṇā na hoti. Catusamuṭṭhānampī ti sabbaṃ catusamuṭṭhānarūpaṃ, na pubbe viya tisamuṭṭhānamevāti adhippāyo. Pubbaṅgamattā oḷārikattā ca phassacetanāva saṅkhārakkhandhoti gahitā, na aññesaṃ abhāvā. Ekadesameva sammasanto ti yathāuddiṭṭhaṃ atthaṃ heṭṭhā anavasesato aniddisitvā ekadesameva niddisanavasena desanāya āmasanto. Imasmiṃ ṭhāne ti yathāuddiṭṭhassa atthassa ‘‘ajjhattikañceva, āvuso, cakkhu’’ntiādinā (ma. ni. 1.306) chadvāravasena niddisanaṭṭhāne. Heṭṭhā parihīnadesana nti – ‘‘yaṃ upādārūpaṃ cattāro arūpino khandhā upari tīṇi ariyasaccānī’’ti niddesavasena parihīnaṃ atthajātaṃ sabbaṃ. Taṃtaṃdvāravasenā ti cakkhudvārādikaṃ taṃtaṃdvāravasena. Catusaccavasena āraddhā desanā catusacceneva pariyosāpitāti āha ‘‘yathānusandhināva suttantaṃ niṭṭhapesī’’ ti.
entries.chinese_simplified: 生起后即灭的有分心，是转向心的缘，所以说“它虽已灭……”。所谓已入迟钝状态，是就被浓厚的睡眠所征服者而言；至于被昏沉(kapimiddha)所困者，其有分心有时也能成为转向心的缘。所谓有分时，即是在有分持续活动的时候；对于熟练禅那、熟练业处、熟练经典者，由于他们的熟练，即使没有作意，心念也能生起。譬如，由于熟练而持续不断地诵习一部熟练的经典时，因为心在别处，所以不会注意到“已经诵了这么多，还剩下这么多”。所谓四因所生色，是指一切四因所生色，其意为不像之前那样仅是三因所生。仅因是前行且粗显，故触与思被执为行蕴，并非因其他行蕴心所不存在。所谓仅触及一部分，即是对于已指出的义理，在下文中没有无遗漏地解说，而是仅以指示一部分的方式来触及教法。于此之处，即是在以“贤友(āvuso)，内在的眼……”等六门的方式来指示如前所述的义理之处。所谓下文省略的教法，即是“所取色、四无色蕴、上面的三圣谛”这一解释中所有被省略的义理。所谓以各个门的方式，即是以眼门等各个门的方式。以四谛开始的教法，也以四谛结束，故说“他依照前后关联结束了经”。
entries.english: The life-continuum consciousness that has just arisen and ceased becomes a condition for the adverting consciousness; thus it is said, 'that which has ceased…' Affected by sluggishness: this is said with reference to one who is overcome by deep sleep; but for one afflicted by 'monkey-sleep,' the life-continuum consciousness would only sometimes be a condition for adverting. At the very time of the life-continuum means at the time of the occurrence of the life-continuum itself. For those proficient in jhāna, proficient in a meditation subject, or proficient in the texts, attention proceeds even without advertence, simply because of their proficiency. For example, when one is reciting a familiar text continuously, as if without a break, because of being proficient, there is no marking, 'So much of the text has passed, so much remains,' due to being engaged otherwise. Of fourfold origin: the intention is that all materiality is of fourfold origin, not just of triple origin as before. Contact and volition alone are taken as the aggregate of formations because they are primary and coarse, not because the others are absent. Touching upon only a part means touching upon the teaching by way of indicating only a part, without indicating exhaustively below the meaning as it was stated. In this place means in the place where the meaning of what was stated is indicated by way of the six doors, with the words 'The internal eye, friends…' (MN 1.306), etc. The teaching below is deficient: the entire body of meaning that was omitted by way of the explanation: 'derived materiality, the four immaterial aggregates, and the three noble truths above.' By way of the respective doors means by way of the respective doors, the eye-door, etc. The discourse that was begun in terms of the four truths is concluded in terms of the four truths; thus he said: 'He concluded the sutta in accordance with its own connection.'

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门-名色分别 Abhidhammāvatāro-Nāmarūpaparicchedo
entries.pali: Pariciṇṇavasībhūtā, jhānā vuṭṭhāya pañcamā; Cinteti daṇḍādānādirūpadosamabhiṇhaso.
entries.chinese_simplified: 于禅那熟练自在，从第五禅出定后，彼再再思惟色身有杖罚等过患。
entries.english: Having become a master of the jhānas through practice, emerging from the fifth jhāna, one reflects repeatedly on the faults of form, such as being liable to be struck with sticks.
